subject: Next steps: vendor paperwork & payment path for Acme Analytics

Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & quick asks — vendor paperwork / payment path

Hi Tina — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and three concrete asks so we can unblock finance/procurement on your side: 

Summary of call:
- You’re piloting Redwood for a cross-team search augmentation POC (team: Analytics).
- Procurement prefers centralized PO billing for enterprise contracts; card preferred for small, one-off purchases.
- Primary procurement questions are around vendor packet, tax form (W-9/W-8), remit address, EIN, and bank/billing instructions. Also asked whether we can appear on AWS Marketplace for consolidated billing.

Asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm preferred payment path for the POC (PO or card). If PO, confirm whether standard net30 is acceptable or if net45 is required.
2) Can you share Acme’s vendor intake form or any required PO terms (we saw your questionnaire during the call — attaching for reference)?
3) I’m attaching a draft Redwood vendor packet + our W-9. If procurement needs ACH instructions instead of a credit-card tokenization flow, let me know and I’ll attach bank remittance info and an ACH authorization stub.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Packet_ACME_20260929.pdf, Redwood_W9_20260929.pdf (sample), Acme_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf

I’ll loop in Ben (billing ops) and Rishi (enterprise sales lead) on the next email to confirm terms and any internal approvals. Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0148
From: Tina Park <tina.park@acmeanalytics.com>

Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & quick asks — vendor paperwork / payment path

Marissa — thanks for the clear notes. A few quick answers from procurement: 

1) For the pilot (PO that covers the initial months) — our standard is net30 but our finance team may approve net45 on a case-by-case basis. For initial PO we can do net30; we may request net45 if approval is needed for an incremental contract.

2) I attached our completed questionnaire and highlighted the most important fields: legal entity name, EIN, remit address, invoicing email, and whether you support consolidated billing via AWS Marketplace. We do prefer marketplace billing when possible.

3) Can you provide the following in your vendor packet: 
   - Legal entity & DBA variance (if any)
   - Full remit address for PO and invoices
   - EFT/ACH banking details or instructions for wires (we can provide an ACH authorization form)
   - Contact for tax/1099 questions

We’d also need a copy of the executed contract (DocuSign) once terms are agreed. Sending this to procurement now; I’ll wait for your vendor packet and W-9.

Thanks — Tina

Tina Park
Head of Procurement | Acme Analytics
tina.park@acmeanalytics.com | +1 212-555-0199

(Attachment: Acme_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf)

Ben / Rishi — forwarding Tina’s reply and Acme’s questionnaire. Key asks from procurement: legal entity & EIN, remit address, EFT/ACH banking info or wire instructions, and confirmation whether we can route billing via AWS Marketplace. They indicated pilot will go on a PO (net30 acceptable, net45 possible later).

Can you: 
- Ben: prepare a slim vendor packet that includes legal name, EIN, remit address, and either (a) our ACH instructions or (b) a note that Redwood requires DocuSign to release banking info on a per-account basis. If we can pre-share ACH instr, include it in the packet.
- Rishi: advise if marketplace listing (AWS) is viable for consolidated billing with Acme — if not, we’ll propose the PO with net30.

I attached an internal-onboarding-checklist.xlsx to track required fields. We need to get final packet to Tina by EOD tomorrow to keep the POC kickoff on schedule.

Thanks — Marissa
